create_imageupscaler: create an ImageUpscaler instance to lazily load Real-ESRGAN weights and upscale image frames
upscale_frames: upscale a list of HWC uint8 numpy frames using Real-ESRGAN with configurable scale and precision
build_net_from_state_dict: build a Real-ESRGAN network from a checkpoint by auto-detecting SRVGGNetCompact or RRDBNet architecture
resolve_model_path: resolve a model path from a local file or download Real-ESRGAN weights from HuggingFace
create_upscaler_model: create an UpscalerModel wrapping a Real-ESRGAN network for single-frame upscaling inference
